summary:
Phase P5 sequential consumer closure: integrate the accepted Core SwiftPM target-path truth into the existing AlembicPlugin five-tool implementation and close the exact real BiliDili Graph failure without another speculative ranking round.

Fixed provenance and first action:
- Plugin baseline is commit a1f3282e2f29af9fb25ff1c7a12125814b757a19.
- Core producer is accepted commit ce1a29a16bbc7239b3fdfedc466fef6c45e02c44.
- Use the existing `@alembic/core` local file dependency. Build Core and refresh the Plugin dependency/runtime artifacts so every probe demonstrably uses ce1a29a. Do not update vendor or release pointers.
- Before changing Plugin source, rerun the focused Graph fixture and fresh-process public Graph probes. If the Core integration alone resolves the failure, make no source edit and return an explicit no-change/no-new-commit conclusion with provenance. Only if the same public call still fails may you trace that exact chain and make the smallest evidenced Plugin correction; do not add another broad ranking heuristic.

Required real read-only probes:
1) AlembicWorkspace query `HostMcpServer ProjectLocationService request` must retain exact file plus same-name symbol representation for both identifiers, bounded results, complete repo coverage, no irrelevant weak-scope degradation, and no errors.
2) BiliDili query `VideoPlayLoadGenerationGate HomeRequestRefreshGate request` must retain exact file plus same-name symbol representation for both identifiers from the real SwiftPM target paths, with bounded results and no AOXPlayer/common-token starvation or irrelevant weak-scope degradation.
- Capture ProjectContext/Core provenance and public JSON summaries. Do not write/rescan/repair either knowledge base or modify either real project.

Regression and packaging:
- Preserve accepted public Search/Prime orphan filtering, Recipe drift truth/deduplication, Guard behavior, exact Graph/file queries, request-scoped roots, read-only behavior, budgets and public schemas.
- Run focused Graph/Search/Prime/Recipe/read-only tests, full Plugin unit suite, check, build, runtime-package/distribution/Codex-plugin verification, canonical local plugin reload, and fresh-process readback of exact Plugin/Core provenance.
- If a Plugin source change is truly required, commit only that minimal change. Otherwise retain a1f3282 and provide the repository-clean no-commit reason.

Forbidden: Test dispatch; Alembic/AlembicCore/BiliDili/AlembicWorkspace source edits; live DB/vector/index writes; Git/host/admin/intent/knowledge-state/tool-visibility gates; new environment chains; new broad ranking work; vendor/marketplace/release changes.

Completion means the controller can rerun the same two real public Graph queries on the installed plugin and then perform the remaining direct five-tool acceptance. It does not by itself complete or archive the demand.
